name: Vanity Mirror
description: The subject catches warm, faintly golden vanity-bulb light on a real honed-tile bathroom counter, brass fixtures softening out of focus behind it — human-scale, lived-in intimacy rather than a spa-brochure fantasy.
lighting: Warm tungsten-equivalent vanity-bulb light, soft and golden
subject: product
prompt: the subject staged on a real bathroom vanity, warm tungsten-equivalent vanity light glowing from above the mirror and catching its upper surfaces with a soft golden highlight, the brass tap softly visible and falling out of focus behind the subject, shallow depth of field with the tile and brass falling softly out of focus behind the sharp subject, brass fixtures and tile in a real lived-in bathroom, genuine warm-bulb color temperature with true brass specular highlights, no visible face, no other people in frame, clean editorial product-photography finish
